description: Returns agents ranked by health score, best first. Each row has the agent key and name, grade (A-F), composite score on a 0-1 scale (a stored score when one exists, otherwise computed live from the last 30 days of metrics), data completeness (share of score inputs that had data; 0 = no data at all) and a stale flag (no call in the last 48 hours). Averages across all agents are computed here from the returned rows. Use this to identify top and bottom performers. Requires an API key with the 'read' scope.

limit.description: Maximum number of agents to show (default: 20)

name: metrx_get_rankings
title: Get Agent Rankings
